scope: New candidate purchase-concept follow-up. Supplements v2/v3; no production RetailSKU, stock integration or corpus acceptance decision.
region_method: Issue12 clarification: current official region-neutral product/category plus official Saint Petersburg delivery presence. AVAILABLE means catalogue-level market compatibility, not live selected-store stock.

exclusions.reason: Vanilla sugar containing extract is not standalone vanilla extract.
Yellow mustard seeds for sowing are gardening goods, not edible prepared mustard.
Current indexed title but page says failed to load selected product; no composition proof of yellow grade.
Soy fuju salad is not asparagus vegetable.
Canned peaches in syrup are not fresh peaches.
Parboiled rice not used to prove plain white rice; explicit Basmati white long-grain record used.
Marinated pork loin preparation is not plain raw pork loin.
Processed smoked-cooked loin is not raw pork loin.

search_limitations: No qualifying official standalone vanilla extract, plain canola oil or fresh kale located in these bounded queries. Empty or unrelated search results are UNCERTAIN, not market absence.
Okey official exact vanilla queries yielded no qualifying current SPB or region-neutral product. No generic browser-access blocker claimed.
Old 2024/2025 regional flyers excluded even where search crawl/publication metadata appears recent.
